questions.stem:
Which types of Cyber Forensic Tools are used
for gather the relevant data from media storage device  during the
investigation of cybercrime?
questions.explanation: Forensic acquisition uses both hardware and software tools.

questions.stem: Which forensic tool is not made in China?
questions.explanation: EnCase/FTK/TSK are not China-origin tools; answer is none of these as ‘Chinese-made’.
